tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18 at peak, service unhealthy). v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error (partial failure, leaving the service mixed across versions); a retry completed the rollout to all three regions. Post-rollback status: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy; the orchestrator partial failure should be investigated separately.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and it's healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy release that was failing. Since v2.3.0 has been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Rollout hiccup:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, which left the service mixed across versions. I retried the same rollback, and it completed across all regions. The orchestrator partial failure should be investigated separately.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. The first attempt timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key, which ensures only one incident is created. The summary covers the failure, the rollback, the partial failure, and the follow-up to investigate v2.3.1 before any redeploy.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy one currently running in all three regions. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.

us-east is now on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. The rollout halted, so I'll retry the same rollback to finish the remaining regions.
The rollback is complete and checkout-api is healthy again. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
